helpDescription: Find an answer, check the platform status, or reach a human on the Asynchrone Space team.
faqDescription: Answers to the most common questions about plans, data and features.
contactDescription: Open a support ticket. The page you came from, the app version and recent errors are attached so we can help faster.
statusDescription: Live availability of every app and the history of past incidents. Subscribe there to be told about outages.
policyDescription: Channels, support hours and first-response targets for your plan.

sev1.name: Sev 1 — Critical
sev1.description: The service is unavailable, data is lost or at risk, or there is a security incident. No workaround.

sev2.name: Sev 2 — High
sev2.description: A major feature is broken or badly degraded for many users, and the workaround is painful.

sev3.name: Sev 3 — Normal
sev3.description: A partial problem with a workaround, a question, or a how-to request.

targetHours: {hours, plural, one {# business hour} other {# business hours}}
targetDays: {days, plural, one {# business day} other {# business days}}
hoursSummary: Support hours: Monday to Friday, 9:00–18:00 Paris time, excluding French public holidays. There is no 24/7 coverage.

page.metadataDescription: How to reach the Asynchrone Space support team, our hours, severity levels and first-response targets per plan.
page.title: How we support you
page.description: Every plan can reach a human. Here is how, when, and how fast.
page.contactDescription: From any app, open Help → Contact support: the ticket carries the page, version and recent errors, so we skip the back-and-forth. You can also email {email}.
page.targetsDescription: Targets are for a first human response during support hours, not for a fix. We set the severity from the impact you report and may adjust it during triage.
page.statusDescription: Outages and maintenance are announced on the status page, with the incident history. Subscribe there to get updates by email.
